name: What kind of maintenance does decorative wall molding require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does decorative wall molding require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decorative wall molding requires minimal maintenance once installed and finished. Regular dusting and occasional cleaning with a damp cloth are usually sufficient to keep it looking its best. For painted molding, minor touch-ups might be needed over time to address scuffs or chips. For wood molding, occasional re-staining or conditioning might be required to preserve its finish. Avoiding harsh chemicals and abrasive cleaners will help maintain the molding's integrity and appearance. Maine Results, Inc. uses durable materials and quality finishes to ensure longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Molding needs minimal maintenance, primarily dusting and occasional cleaning. Painted molding may need touch-ups over time.
